description: Contract V3 adds semantic capability parity enforcement. Promotes five previously-optional sections to REQUIRED after M47 candidate demonstrated material regression. Adds hard commitment granularity and NPM requirements. M47 candidate would FAIL this contract.
why_v3: M47 human review (M47.1) found 7 semantic regressions vs M37.8 trusted baseline. EIV V1 was too permissive — it checked minimum structure but not semantic richness. Contract V2 had what_evidence_shows/what_management_says/where_management_was_consistent/management_consistency_map/what_may_mean_economically as OPTIONAL — LLM omitted all five. Contract V3 makes them REQUIRED.

simple_answer.constraint: Must contain factual grounding: specific counts, behavioral descriptor verbatim, named items — not only editorial synthesis
simple_answer.semantic_purpose: Primary investor summary anchored in canonical evidence
simple_answer.min_content: behavioral descriptor verbatim + at least 2 factual counts (delivery count, commitment count, or financial metric)

key_points.constraint: At least 3 entries; at least one must contain factual specifics (counts, named items, lifecycle states)
key_points.semantic_purpose: Scannable factual takeaways for investor decision support
key_points.min_content: 3 items, at least 1 with delivery count or financial figure

what_evidence_shows.constraint: Non-empty list with >= 2 entries; each entry must reference observable events, not only conclusions
what_evidence_shows.semantic_purpose: Evidence transparency: investor sees what actually happened, enabling independent verification
what_evidence_shows.min_content: 2 bullets referencing specific progression items, commitment outcomes, or observable risk events
what_evidence_shows.upgrade_from_v2: Was OPTIONAL in V2 — M47 candidate omitted entirely. Now REQUIRED.
what_evidence_shows.why_required: Evidence density: investors need observable facts, not only synthesis. M47.1: absence is SEMANTIC_REGRESSION severity=SIGNIFICANT

what_management_says.constraint: Non-empty list with >= 1 entry; must quote or paraphrase actual disclosed management intentions
what_management_says.semantic_purpose: Management's stated intentions vs actual delivery — required for follow-through assessment
what_management_says.min_content: 1 bullet paraphrasing management's stated strategic intentions from canonical evidence
what_management_says.upgrade_from_v2: Was OPTIONAL in V2. Now REQUIRED.
what_management_says.why_required: Management's stated intentions are a required input for evaluating follow-through. M47.1: absence is SEMANTIC_REGRESSION severity=SIGNIFICANT

where_management_was_consistent.constraint: Non-empty list with >= 1 entry; must name specific dimensions where consistency was observed
where_management_was_consistent.semantic_purpose: Positive evidence of reliability in specific domains — separates weak areas from consistent areas
where_management_was_consistent.min_content: 1 bullet naming at least one dimension with observed consistency pattern
where_management_was_consistent.upgrade_from_v2: Was OPTIONAL in V2. Now REQUIRED.
where_management_was_consistent.why_required: Consistency map requires this foundation. M47.1: absence is SEMANTIC_REGRESSION severity=SIGNIFICANT

management_consistency_map.constraint: Dict with >= 3 entries; each entry must have a status (CONSISTENT/INCONSISTENT/UNABLE_TO_VERIFY/DELAYED)
management_consistency_map.semantic_purpose: Structured dimension-by-dimension consistency map for investor decision support
management_consistency_map.upgrade_from_v2: Was OPTIONAL in V2. Now REQUIRED.
management_consistency_map.why_required: Machine-readable consistency map is core investor value. M47.1: absence is SEMANTIC_REGRESSION severity=SIGNIFICANT

what_may_mean_economically.constraint: Non-empty string; must contain at least one financial metric (margin %, revenue, PAT, NPM) relevant to management assessment
what_may_mean_economically.semantic_purpose: Economic interpretation of management evidence — links management quality to investment thesis
what_may_mean_economically.min_content: 1 sentence with specific financial metric; must not be speculative forward-looking inference
what_may_mean_economically.upgrade_from_v2: Was OPTIONAL in V2. Now REQUIRED.
what_may_mean_economically.why_required: Economic context connects management evidence to investor thesis. M47.1: absence is SEMANTIC_REGRESSION severity=SIGNIFICANT

what_is_not_yet_proven.constraint: Non-empty string; must name at least one specific commitment, risk, or disclosure pattern — not only abstract generic questions
what_is_not_yet_proven.semantic_purpose: Investor uncertainty map: what to withhold conviction on until resolved
what_is_not_yet_proven.min_content: At least one named specific: commitment name, filing deadline, risk category, quantified target
what_is_not_yet_proven.evidence_source: management_quality_summary.json.unresolved → MUST BE ENRICHED with named commitment IDs
what_is_not_yet_proven.v3_requirement: Must not be raw mq_summary.unresolved output. Must name specific commitments or risks from canonical evidence.
what_is_not_yet_proven.why_required: M47 regression: raw unresolved list is too generic for investor use. M37.8 named Nidlegy, carbon reduction, supply chain, FX, IP.

deterministic_precision_facts.constraint: List with >= 3 entries; each must have metric, value, semantic_meaning; commitment DPF must include granularity beyond total+UTV
deterministic_precision_facts.min_content: delivery DPF + commitment DPF with hard/delivered breakdown + financial DPF
deterministic_precision_facts.v3_requirement: Commitment DPF must include hard commitment count when hard commitments exist (not just total + UTV)

what_to_monitor.constraint: List with >= 3 items; each item must be a specific named actionable monitor — not a bare category label
what_to_monitor.min_content: 3 items, each >25 chars, referencing specific metrics, products, filings, or named risks
what_to_monitor.evidence_source: management_quality_summary.json.what_to_watch → MUST BE ENRICHED with specific named items
what_to_monitor.v3_requirement: Must not be raw mq_summary.what_to_watch. Must be enriched with specific trackable items from canonical evidence.

behavioral_descriptor.constraint: Must appear verbatim in simple_answer; must match canonical descriptor from management_progression
behavioral_descriptor.semantic_purpose: Canonical delivery state anchoring synthesis to evidence
behavioral_descriptor.evidence_source: derived deterministically from management_progression.json via fact_pack

deterministic_semantic_sections.description: Sections that must be pre-populated deterministically from canonical data BEFORE LLM generation. LLM may enrich but cannot omit or overwrite.

hard_commitment_count.derivation: management_commitments.json → items where expected_timeframe is a specific date (not unspecified/ongoing)
hard_commitment_count.purpose: Enables hard commitment granularity in DPFs and simple_answer

npm.derivation: financial_truth_pack.json → PAT / Revenue for latest year
npm.purpose: NPM belongs in DPF financial scale and what_may_mean_economically

deterministic_assembler_provides: commitment counts and status including hard_commitment_count
deterministic_precision_facts entries (with hard commitment granularity and NPM)
what_is_not_yet_proven enriched with named commitments from hard_commitments list
what_to_monitor enriched with specific named items from evidence
llm_vs_deterministic_boundary_v3.invariant: LLM prose cannot overwrite or remove deterministic sections. If LLM omits a section that assembler pre-populated, assembler preserves it.
llm_vs_deterministic_boundary_v3.upgrade_from_v2: V2 had what_evidence_shows/what_management_says/where_management_was_consistent/management_consistency_map/what_may_mean_economically in LLM-only territory — LLM failed to generate them. V3 assembler pre-populates skeletons so LLM compression cannot remove them.

release_eligibility.condition: PACP_PASS AND EIV_V2_PASS AND SEMANTIC_PARITY_PASS AND ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_VALID
release_eligibility.eiv_v2_role: Tests investor completeness including capability parity (EIV-MQ-09..16 in addition to EIV-MQ-01..08)
release_eligibility.note: EIV V1 PASS alone is no longer sufficient. M47 demonstrated EIV V1 passing answer can be materially weaker than certified baseline.
